trickyParts: Sending the start message after the Envoy role claim was flaky (4/30): the listener forwards a role-lane card as soon as it records the role, which can reach the session before claimEnvoyRole resolves; the send now happens right after claims/register, before the role claim and the subscription.

Oh My Pi's TUI render is throttled, so the claim's first daemon requests can precede the first painted frame by ~25 ms in some runs; the command still runs after Oh My Pi's startup code (startupComplete) and the start turn always comes after the first frame.
extensions/legion.test.ts mocks nats process-wide, so controller-start-omp.test.ts (real NATS) runs in its own process via the package test script.
deviations: Worked from plan.md version 2 and spec version 3 (the architect's scope change on 2026-10-27): task 5 (pi-envoy deferral), A6 and A13 are not in this pull request; they are built and proven on branch legion/INFRA-511-startup-wait (on #2278's head) for INFRA-497's implementer to move into #2278.

Architect-approved design change: the operator controller's whole claim runs from /legion-controller-start instead of session_start, so LEGION-392's order holds on main's pi-envoy; the claim refusal is shown as a warning notice from the command.
Daemon API contract is 41, not 40: main released 40 for the awaiting_person change while this was open (collision note).
The plan's pi_legion path-filter edit was unnecessary: the filter already listed packages/pi-envoy/**.
openQuestions: Residual race, recorded in the PR body: a message sent straight to the new session id between pi-envoy's registration (during startup) and the claim is an ordinary card on main's pi-envoy and can take the first turn.
